items.title: Harold Mabern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010
items.q: He was on one of my favorite record dates “Rakin’ and Scrapin’.” Hugh Walker is on that. Hugh Walker, George Coleman, Blue Mitchell and Bill Lee.

ctx.x: So that’s pretty neat that you’re here.

Hugh Walker is one of those kind of drummers like he carried his own rhythm. He had his rhythm in his hip pocket. I mean the minute he sat down. He was on one of my favorite record dates “Rakin’ and Scrapin’.” Hugh Walker is on that. Hugh Walker, George Coleman, Blue Mitchell and Bill Lee. Yeah, Hugh Walker.
Was there a period of, was there any particular period of time, a decade or whatever, that it got harder to make a living in the jazz world?
